scholarships.title: President's Graduate Fellowship
scholarships.funding_label: Full Tuition Fee Waiver + Monthly Stipend
scholarships.official_source: NUS Graduate School, National University of Singapore

existing.description: The President's Graduate Fellowship is awarded by the NUS Graduate School to PhD candidates who show exceptional promise or accomplishment in research, and a number of PhD research students are selected each semester by the University. It is open to Singapore Citizens, Singapore Permanent Residents and all international students, covers a full waiver of tuition fees at the University and pays a monthly stipend of SGD 3,900 for international students, SGD 4,400 for Permanent Residents and SGD 4,800 for Singapore Citizens, with CPF contributions on top for Citizens. International students additionally receive a one-off settling allowance of S$1,000 and a one-off air travel allowance of up to S$750, and from the AY2023/24 intake recipients are eligible for the NUSGS Research Incentive Award. The Fellowship is tenable for one year in the first instance, renewable each semester, with a maximum period of four years, and is awarded by faculty/department nomination only.
eligibility: Nationalities: Singapore Citizens, Singapore Permanent Residents, All International Students
Scholarship holders can pursue any graduate programme
No specific academic pre-requisites stated on the official page
Must be nominated by the Faculty/Department (the award is by nomination only)
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to PhD candidates of all nationalities - Singapore Citizens, Singapore Permanent Residents and international students - who show exceptional promise or accomplishment in research and can pursue any graduate programme at NUS. The official page states 'No specific academic pre-requisites.' The Fellowship is awarded by nomination only, so candidates cannot apply for it directly.

One-off air travel allowance of up to S$750 for a single-trip economy-class airfare from the student's home country to Singapore (newly registered international students only)
CPF contributions on top of the stipend for Singapore Citizens

application_method: Apply for PhD admission at NUS in the normal way; the Fellowship cannot be applied for directly
The Faculty/Department nominates the applicant during the PhD admissions assessment

existing.selection_notes: A number of PhD research students are selected each semester by the University for the award. Successful applicants are informed of the outcome sometime in May (for admission in August) or October (for admission in January) and must sign a letter of undertaking. The Fellowship is tenable for one (1) year in the first instance and thereafter may, subject to the Recipient's satisfactory progress, be renewed each semester at the University's discretion, with a maximum period of four (4) years.
existing.best_fit: Exceptional PhD research candidates at NUS of any nationality who can be nominated by their faculty or department; international candidates gain the highest-value NUS PhD package, including a one-off airfare and settling allowance.
existing.notes: Stipend figures shown are the international-student rate because this row targets international applicants. The NUSGS Research Incentive Award monthly allowance is not quantified on the official page, which states NUS Graduate School reserves the right to adjust or revise it. The stored record's official_source_url already points at this Fellowship's own NUS Graduate School page, so no URL correction was needed.
existing.duration: One (1) year in the first instance, renewable each semester; maximum period four (4) years. Typical award period for PhD students is 4 years.
existing.application_period: Nominated by the Faculty/Department as part of the NUS PhD admissions cycle for the August (Semester 1) or January (Semester 2) intake; outcome notified in May for August admission or October for January admission.
existing.deadline_display: No scholarship deadline is published because the Fellowship is by nomination. The official page's 'Application Deadlines' table shows only 'Please refer to faculty websites for respective application deadlines' for the August (Semester 1) and January (Semester 2) intakes, and states that 'Successful applicants will be informed of the outcome of their applications sometime in May (for admission in August) or October (for admission in January).'

scholarships.title: NUS International Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.funding_label: Full Tuition Fee Coverage + Living and Accommodation Allowances
scholarships.official_source: National University of Singapore, Office of Admissions

existing.description: The NUS International Undergraduate Scholarship is a University-level scholarship offered by the National University of Singapore to support exceptional students from all countries except Singapore who apply as freshmen to a full-time undergraduate degree programme at NUS. Candidates are considered and shortlisted through their application for undergraduate admission to NUS, and selection interviews are held from January to July with outcomes notified by mid-July. Benefits comprise 100% coverage of subsidised undergraduate tuition fees after the MOE Tuition Grant, an S$5,800 annual living allowance, an S$5,000 annual accommodation allowance and a S$1,750 one-time computer allowance upon enrolment. The award is renewed each semester provided the holder maintains a GPA of at least 3.5 (or top 80% of cohort for Dentistry, Law and Medicine) and good conduct.
eligibility: Citizens of all countries, except Singapore
Have strong leadership qualities and potential
Applying for admission to a full-time undergraduate degree programme at NUS
Transfer applicants from local or overseas universities are not eligible
existing.eligibility_summary: For citizens of all countries except Singapore, applying as a freshman to a full-time undergraduate degree programme at NUS with outstanding high school results, strong leadership qualities and potential, and an outstanding co-curricular activities record. Transfer applicants from local or overseas universities are not eligible. Candidates are considered and shortlisted through their application for undergraduate admission to NUS.
benefits: 100% coverage of subsidised undergraduate tuition fees (after MOE Tuition Grant)
S$1,750 one-time computer allowance upon enrolment
coverage: 100% coverage of subsidised undergraduate tuition fees (after MOE Tuition Grant, which scholarship recipients must take up)
S$1,750 one-time computer allowance upon enrolment
requirements: Take up the MOE Tuition Grant, which scholarship recipients must do to receive the scholarship

Maintain a Grade Point Average of at least 3.5 (or equivalent), or grades within the top 80% of their cohort for Dentistry, Law and Medicine scholarship recipients, and good conduct, for the scholarship to be renewed each semester
Do not concurrently hold any other scholarship, fellowship, bursary, grant, award or allowance without prior approval from the University
documents: Supporting documents listed in the NUS Scholarships Application Guide
application_method: All eligible students applying for undergraduate admission to NUS will be considered for this scholarship - there is no separate scholarship application
Invited applicants are assessed for scholarship suitability based on the strength of their application
Attend the selection interview(s); only shortlisted applicants are informed by e-mail
Scholarship outcomes are communicated by mid-July
existing.selection_notes: Invited applicants will be assessed for scholarship suitability based on the strength of their application. Only applicants shortlisted for the selection interview(s) will be informed via e-mail. Selection interview(s) will be conducted from January to July, and interviewed candidates will be informed of the scholarship outcomes by mid-July. NUS reserves the right to not award any scholarship if there are no candidates of sufficient merit, and the decision of the selection committee is final.
existing.best_fit: Exceptional new international or Singapore Permanent Resident school-leavers applying to a full-time NUS undergraduate degree programme, with strong leadership and co-curricular records, who are willing to accept the MOE Tuition Grant bond.
existing.notes: Although no bond is attached to the scholarship itself, recipients must take up the MOE Tuition Grant, which bonds Singapore Permanent Residents and international students to work for a Singapore-registered company for three years immediately after graduation. Scholarship recipients admitted to Dentistry and Medicine must additionally undertake a service bond with the Singapore Ministry of Health for five and six years respectively. The scholarship does not cover the NUS Bachelor of Science / University of Melbourne Doctor of Veterinary Medicine Concurrent Degree Programme, and for other Concurrent Degree Programmes it covers only the undergraduate programme.
existing.duration: The scholarship is tenable for the normal candidature period and can be transferred across programmes; renewed every semester provided the GPA and conduct conditions are met.
existing.application_period: Considered automatically through the NUS undergraduate admissions application; selection interviews are conducted from January to July and interviewed candidates are informed of scholarship outcomes by mid-July. For AY2027/2028 the NUS admissions application form is currently shown as CLOSED, so the next cycle has not yet opened as at 2026-10-04.
existing.deadline_display: The official 'Important Dates and Application' page lists the Application Period for the NUS International Undergraduate Scholarship as "Based on admissions application timeline." The NUS admissions 'Important Dates' page shows the AY2027/2028 application windows as "16 December 2026 to 4 January 2027 [Closed]" (NUS High School Diploma), "16 December 2026 to 3 February 2027 [Closed]" (Polytechnic Diploma from Singapore), "16 December 2026 to 17 February 2027 [Closed]" (IB Diploma) and "18 February 2027 (Late Afternoon) to 19 March 2027 [Closed]" (Singapore-Cambridge GCE A-Level), with "Application Form: CLOSED".
